title: Dark Iron Deposit
wikitext:
[[File:Dark iron deposit.png|right]]
'''Dark Iron Deposit''' is a mining mineral node found only in the [[Burning Steppes]] dungeon and in the [[Searing Gorge]] raid. 

==Patch changes==
* [[File:WoWlogo.png|40px]] '''Patch 1.7.0 (2005-09-13):''' Dark Iron mineral nodes will now sometimes appear in the Burning Steppes and Searing Gorge.
